text:
marie: Heads-up: rolling embed-service canary started in change-window-2. Metrics look green initially but dashboard sampling shows p95 flicker +60ms. tagging @aj @sam

deploy-bot: Deploy started by marie — change-window-2 — canary: v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2 — cohort: eu-west nodes (2/6)

aj: saw the p95 blip, small sample. Is this cohort-only or aggregated?

marie: cohort-only on eu-west canary nodes. dashboard: https://console.redwood/dash/embed-service?slo=p95&range=1h

sam: adding traces, will post trace ids if it repeats

srebot: Alert: slo.p95 > threshold (embed-service, eu-west, 2m) — count: 12 — action: watcher opened #observability-ticket-381

aj: can we pin traffic away from eu-west for canary? recommend pausing next wave and pin to 0 for eu-west

marie: holding traffic shift, pausing next wave. @deploy-bot pause

deploy-bot: Received pause. Pausing rollout at step 2. All subsequent waves will be held.

sam: quick check — KV cache miss rate ticked up in same timeframe. maybe GC overlapped with canary ramp?

aj: checking node logs, snippet:
```
2026-03-21T16:12:34Z cache: gc run, reclaimed 12MB
2026-03-21T16:12:35Z serve: p95=340ms
```

marie: good catch. looks like GC overlap with canary traffic. recommend rollback to v3.2.1 on eu-west-only while we investigate

aj: agree. rolling back canary in eu-west only. @deploy-bot rollback eu-west v3.2.1

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for cohort eu-west. ETA ~45s. Notifying oncall.

sre-oncall: monitoring: watching 5xx and p95. If p95 back to baseline within +10m, plan is to re-run with adjusted cache tuning.

marie: creating post-action checklist: 1) verify kvcache params; 2) add small jitter to GC schedule; 3) rerun canary with 20% slower ramp and extra telemetry

sam: logging note: #incident-embed-20260321 created

aj: :thumbsup:

marie: I'll update release notes and hold change-window tilt until we confirm stability

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for eu-west. All nodes back to v3.2.1.

marie: p95 trending down, looks good. will unhold in 15m if stable

aj: I'll follow up with telemetry snapshot + diff and post to the ticket

sam: opened config PR for GC jitter: https://git.company/repo/pull/1234

marie: thanks team, keeping the hold. will reconvene if anything pops back up
